title: cbuild_assembly
description: A kit's assembly settings, stored in the _cbuild_assembly product meta.

schema_version.description: The document's version. Version 1 is the only one so far.

default_on.description: Whether a build starts with assembly on.

fee.description: The assembly fee in the shop's currency, as a decimal in text: 15 or 15.50. 0 is free.

lead_time.description: The lead time, in the owner's words.

returns_notice.description: The returns notice shown before checkout.
